{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==

* [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Vegetable spray]] or 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 packages (2½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]]) sweet [[Cookbook:Sausage|Italian sausage]]
* 2 cartons (1 pound) [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]], fresh [[cookbook:Mushroom|mushrooms]]
* 1 bag (9 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) fresh [[Cookbook:spinach|baby spinach]]
* 2 cans (1¾ pounds) [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 2 cartons (2 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] / 4 pounds) low-sodium [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 package (1¾ pounds) fresh Three Cheese [[cookbook:Pasta|Tortellini]] (from dairy case)
* Grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]] for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]] (optional)

==Procedure==

# Coat a large [[Cookbook:Stock Pot|stock pot]] with vegetable spray or 1 teaspoon olive oil.
# Remove sausage from casings and heat over medium heat in stock pot until sausage is crumbled and no longer pink.
# When the sausage is completely cooked, add sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are [[Cookbook:Sauté|sautéed]].
# Add the entire bag of baby spinach.
# Cook, stirring occasionally, until spinach is lightly [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sautéed]].
# Add diced tomatoes and stir thoroughly.
# Add chicken broth and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add tortellini and [[Cookbook:Simmer|simmer]] on low for 10–15 minutes until the pasta is cooked.
# [[Cookbook:Ladle|Ladle]] into soup bowls and sprinkle generously with Parmesan cheese.
